reason: A lightweight floating pet experience for browsing pet images and cat facts, saving favorites locally, and configuring image sources and refresh behavior.

summaries.zh: 一款提供可拖动浮动猫咪挂件、宠物图片与猫咪知识浏览、收藏及插件设置的轻量宠物体验插件。
summaries.en: A lightweight pet experience with a draggable floating cat, pet image and cat-fact browsing, local favorites, and plugin-owned settings.

capabilities: Renders a draggable floating cat widget
Browses cat, dog, and fox images through a host allowlisted proxy
Reads and writes plugin-owned settings through a loopback same-origin endpoint
